csv_project_name: Design for Seattle Animal Shelter Facility
csv_agency: City of Seattle Finance & Administrative Services
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Seattle Department of Finance and Administrative Services (FAS), Capital Development Division (CD) is seeking an architectural consultant team to provide programming and predesign services for a new municipal animal shelter facility. Funding for the programming and predesign phase has been secured. Although this RFQ seeks consultant services for programming and predesign, it is the City s intent for the consultant team to also perform design and construction administration services. Funding for the design and construction phase will be determined at a later date following the completion of the programming and predesign phase.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Interior Design/Space Planning, Landscape Architecture, Programming, Civil Engineering, Cost Estimating, Endangered Species Surveys, Environmental Engineering/Planning/Design, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering

title: Design for Seattle Animal Shelter Facility
short_description: Architectural team sought for programming and predesign of a new municipal animal shelter.
project_scope: Programming and predesign for a new municipal animal shelter facility in Seattle. The current procurement funds only the programming and predesign phase, but the City intends the selected consultant team to also perform later design and construction administration services if future funding is secured. Disciplines requested include architecture, interior design/space planning, landscape architecture, programming, civil engineering, cost estimating, endangered species surveys, environmental engineering/planning/design, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, and structural engineering.
services: Architectural consulting services for programming and predesign, with intended continuation into design and construction administration; multidisciplinary team including structural engineering and civil engineering.
relevance_explanation:
- Building project is a municipal animal shelter, which is not a core sbp target type.
- Current scope is mainly programming and predesign led by architecture.
- Structural engineering is included, but no special structural features, spans, or innovative systems are described.
- No indication of long-span roofs, complex façades, bridges, stadiums, or special lightweight structures.
- Potential later design role exists, but project appears to be a conventional general building.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated in the source. Only funding for the programming and predesign phase is confirmed; funding for design and construction will be determined later. No size, area, capacity, or technical parameters are provided to support a realistic cost estimate.
fee_explanation: No fee information is stated in the source. The notice is for consultant selection for programming and predesign, with possible later design and construction administration services, but no compensation, budget, or fee basis is provided.
references_qualifications: Architectural consultant team for programming and predesign of a new municipal animal shelter facility. Requested disciplines include architecture, interior design/space planning, landscape architecture, programming, civil engineering, cost estimating, endangered species surveys, environmental engineering/planning/design, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, and structural engineering. WMBE goal: 51%.
